title: 内角轻移一脚
description: 彩铅表现浅内角里一脚转到邻近踏点、其余接触保持稳定。

art_direction.medium: opaque gouache illustration with broad matte brush marks
art_direction.scene: An original colored-pencil illustration depicts a fictional fully clothed adult transferring one shoe to a nearby positive foothold inside a shallow bouldering corner. The other foot and both hands retain broad secure contacts across the adjoining walls, keeping the body balanced with a modest stance. Avoid extreme splaying or a suspended split; the hips and knees stay natural. Frame the entire adult from a wide oblique angle that reveals both wall planes and thick continuous crash mats. Use cream paper grain, muted coral holds, deep teal clothing, and delicate pencil texture. The landing zone is empty and the action low. No lettering, brands, jumping, or dramatic exposure.
